lines.text: In 1789, a barely literate man named Timothy Dexter became the world's luckiest idiot.
His wealthy rivals constantly tricked him into awful business investments to bankrupt him.
First, they told him to ship heavy bed-warming pans to the tropical Caribbean.
Plantations bought the pans as giant molasses ladles, making Dexter a massive fortune!
Next, rivals told him to ship thousands of stray alley cats to the islands.
A sudden rat plague hit, and locals eagerly bought every single cat!
Furious, rivals told him to ship coal to Newcastle—the coal-mining capital of England.
He arrived during an unexpected miners' strike and sold it for double the profit!
He finally published a book with zero punctuation marks,
adding a whole page of commas and periods at the back,
telling angry readers to 'salt and pepper the words as you please!'
